verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents first-party tool/function calling, where the model requests functions the application defines, so the core capability exists on its open-model endpoints. Nothing in the pack covers parallel tool calls, multi-step agent loops, or how faithfully tool calls are emitted. Structured Outputs is a related but different feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented parallel tool calling, documented multi-step tool use, evidence of tool-call reliability or fidelity, independent hands-on corroboration of agent loops working

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — including parallel and multi-step tool use — so agent loops run on open models without breaking

citations.quote: Tool calling, also known as tool use or function calling, lets a model request functions that your application defines.
